subject: Geo-homing verification and deletion runthrough for Dedicated cluster
messages:
From: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@finsecure.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated region commitment + purge walkthrough request

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we map out final security approval steps for our Dedicated deployment, security needs two confirmations before we can sign: 1) a clear guarantee that tenant traffic and persistent data are homed to the US-west region we agreed on (including backups/snapshots), and 2) a walkthrough of the deletion/erase workflow when we request tenant purge (expecting timelines and evidence artifacts you can provide).

Can your team provide a short runthrough and a sample artifact set (logs, snapshot markers, and playbook steps) that we can hand to our auditors? Attachments or diagrams are helpful.

Thanks —
Carlos Ramirez
Head of InfoSec, FinSecure
[carlos@finsecure.com]

[Attachment: region-diagram.pdf (high-level topology)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@finsecure.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated region commitment + purge walkthrough request

Carlos —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front:
- Yes, for your Dedicated cluster we will pin your tenant to the us-west-2 availability zone(s) you selected; execution is done at provisioning and we do not replicate tenant primary data outside that region for normal backups.
- Backups/snapshots: we retain hourly backups within the same region by default. Cross-region replication is opt-in only and disabled for your account.
- Deletion/purge: we support immediate logical deletion plus an operator-driven physical wipe of local snapshots. The operator wipe triggers a sweep job across the cluster that purges KV stores, removes encrypted blobs, and zeros metadata entries — we can provide a signed wipe manifest and task run logs.

I’ve attached a high-level diagram (region-diagram.pdf) and a draft wipe playbook (wipe-playbook-v2.docx). Laura and Ben will help walk through the exact logs and evidence you’ll need for your auditors — laura, would you and Ben be able to schedule a 30-minute runthrough tomorrow?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

[Attachment: wipe-playbook-v2.docx (internal ops playbook)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@finsecure.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated region commitment + purge walkthrough request

Hi Carlos —

Thanks — I can take the walkthrough. Quick checklist below so we cover everything your auditors typically ask for: 

1) Proof of regional residency at rest
   - Snapshot manifest showing retention and region (signed UTC timestamp)
   - Block device mapping for the tenant's nodes (shows us-west-2 allocation)

2) Backup replication policy and opt-in settings
   - Current config export (we'll attach the replication-matrix.csv)

3) Deletion workflow and evidence artifacts
   - Logical delete request record (API call + job id)
   - Operator-initiated physical wipe job (task id + per-node logs)
   - Final wipe manifest (SHA256 of removed blob list)

4) Timeline expectations
   - Logical delete: immediate (soft delete)
   - Physical wipe start: within 24 hours on business days after approved ticket
   - Evidence delivery: signed manifest + logs within 48 hours of completion

5) Audit/readout format we can provide
   - Signed PDFs, CSV run logs, and an S3-like object list with deleted markers (hashed).

Action items:
- Jonas: please confirm there are no scheduled cross-region replication tasks for FinSecure and attach the current config export.
- Ben: can you prepare a sanitized sample of a wipe task log we can share with FinSecure auditors? (remove IPs/usernames)

I’ll propose two 30-minute slots: Thu 23 May 10:00 AM PDT or Fri 24 May 02:00 PM PDT. Which works?

—Laura Bennett
Principal Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

[Attachment: replication-matrix.csv (current replication settings export)]

From: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@finsecure.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 May 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated region commitment + purge walkthrough request

Laura / Jonas —

Thanks — Fri 24 May 02:00 PM PDT works for us. We appreciate the checklist; two quick clarifications before the call:

1) For the physical wipe, your timeline says "within 24 hours on business days" — can you confirm a guaranteed maximum of 72 hours in case of emergency approvals that come in after hours? Our audit team wants an SLA fallback.
2) For evidence delivery: will the signed manifest include a per-node SHA256 list and the public key used to sign it? We need to validate signatures independently.

If you can confirm both in the call, we should have what we need for the security board. Also, please include a sanitized example of the final signed manifest in the packet so our auditors can confirm the verification process ahead of time.

See you on the call.

—Carlos
Head of InfoSec, FinSecure
[carlos@finsecure.com]
